name: Seventh Day Adventist
overview: Scripture emphasizes the importance of the Sabbath as a holy day set apart by God, intended to be a perpetual covenant and a sign of His sanctifying presence among His people, as seen in Exodus 20:8 and Ezekiel 20:12, 20. The Seventh Day Adventist belief in observing the Sabbath reflects this biblical mandate to remember and keep the day holy. Additionally, the cleansing of the sanctuary mentioned in Daniel 8:14 points to a prophetic understanding tied to God's redemptive plan, while the reference to Jesus departing from the temple in Matthew 24:1 reminds believers of the centrality of Christ in all aspects of faith and worship.
